title: Experimental procedures for TF Perturb-Seq
author: Nan Zhang
materials: Part 1: sgRNA plasmid library construction (UT Southwestern)

Digest 15 ug LentiGuide(10X)-BFP-Puro (LW203) in 200 ul reaction volume with 15 ul NEB Esp3I for 3h and run 0.7% agarose gel to purify the vector. Plasmid map of LentiGuide(10X)-BFP-Puro (LW203): https://benchling.com/s/seq-cp12NBXnolGQY6NSXY5b?m=slm-GTRPOQU0bCAenT5kHEgB Purify with three QIAquick Spin Columns (for DNA size between 70 bps to 10 kbs) and elute with 35 ul EB buffer for each column. Combine three elutions together( 105 ul total). Measure DNA concentration with Qubit kit.
For genomic DNA samples, prepare genomic DNA from >2M cells (or 1000X sgRNA number) using the Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit (Qiagen, Cat. # 69504).
Change the media the next day.
Goal: Generate, harvest, and concentrate sgRNA lentivirus.
Change the media 2 days after the sort.

Part 9: Sequencing Protocol for WTC11 TF Perturb-seq Benchmark Dataset (Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center) Live single cells were isolated by flow cytometry after staining with LIVE/DEAD Violet Viability/Vitality Kit (Invitrogen; L34958).

steps.title: Synthesize and Resuspend sgRNA Oligo Pool
steps.instruction: Synthesize the sgRNA oligo pool using Twist Bioscience (sequences derived from Replogle et al. 2022; Lenti-Guide(10X) backbone: GTGGAAAGGACGAAACACCGNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNgtttaagagctaagctggaaacagc).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the sgRNA oligo pool in low EDTA TE buffer to a concentration of 0.5 ng/ul (~0.024uM).

steps.title: Amplify sgRNA Library by PCR
steps.instruction: Perform PCR to amplify double-stranded sgRNAs (139-bp fragments) using library-fwd (taacttgaaagtatttcgatttcttggctttatatatcttGTGGAAAGGACGAAACACCG) and library-rev (gttgataacggactagccttatttaaacttgctatgctgtttccagcttagctcttaaac) primers from IDT.

substeps.instruction: Set up 4 tubes of 50 ul PCR reactions (total 3.2 ng sgRNA oligos) containing: 2.5 ul 10 uM library-fwd + library-rev primers, 1.6 ul sgRNA oligo pool (0.5 ng/ul), 20.9 ul H2O, and 25 ul 2X KAPA HotStart Readymix (Roche, Cat. # 7958935001).
Run PCR program: 95C for 30s; 5 cycles of (98C for 20s, 59C for 15s, 72C for 10s); 5 cycles of (98C for 20s, 65C for 15s, 72C for 10s); 72C for 60s; hold at 4C.
Combine reactions and run a 1.2% Agarose gel to purify 139 bp products using Qiagen MinElute Gel Extraction Kit.
Purify with 2 MinElute Spin Columns and elute with 12 ul EB buffer per column (Total 24 ul).
Measure DNA concentration with Qubit kit.

steps.title: Assemble sgRNA Library
steps.instruction: Assemble the double-stranded sgRNA library into the lentiviral backbone using NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly (NEB, Cat. # E2621X).

substeps.instruction: Set up 2 tubes of 80 ul reactions containing: 500 ng Esp3I digested LentiGuide(10X)-BFP-Puro, 20 ng sgRNA PCR library, water to 50 ul, and 50 ul NEB HIFI DNA assembly Master Mix.
Incubate at 50C for 60 min.

Purify assembled DNA with 0.8X SPRIselect beads (Beckman Coulter, Cat. # B23318): mix 160 ul (0.8X) beads with 200 ul PCR reactions, incubate at RT for 5 min, and hold on magnet until supernatant is clear.
Wash beads three times with 500 ul 80% ethanol.
Elute in 20 ul EB buffer and measure DNA concentration with Qubit kit.

steps.title: Transform and Amplify Plasmid Library
steps.instruction: Electroporate the ligated DNA into Lucigen Endura Duo competent cells using a BioRAD MicroPulser Electroporator.

substeps.instruction: Electroporate 25 ul E.coli + 2 ul ligated DNA (>50 ng) using a 0.1 cm cuvette (Note: use 100 ng plasmid library for pre-made libraries). Repeat for a second electroporation.
Add 2 ml SOC recovery media and transfer to 14 ml tubes; culture at 37C shaker for 1 h.
Spread 0.05, 0.01, and 0.001 ul E.coli media mixed with 50 ul LB onto Agarose plates and culture at 37C overnight.
Count colonies to ensure >1000 clones per sgRNA in 2 ml culture.
Transfer 4 ml E.coli culture (stored at 4C O/N) to a flask with 300 ml fresh LB + 150 ug/ml ampicillin and culture at 37C shaker for 16 hours.
Pellet E.coli and extract plasmids with Zymo Midiprep kit.
Elute plasmids with 250 ul + 200 ul elution buffer and measure DNA concentration.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Amplicons for Bulk Sequencing
steps.instruction: Construct NGS libraries from sgRNA plasmid library or genomic DNA (from iPSCs/hESCs before differentiation or ~5 days before harvest).

substeps.instruction: 1st Round PCR: Set up 4-12 tubes (100 ul each) containing: 5 ul 10 uM Fwd-v2 primer (ACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCTgaaagtatttcgatttcttggct), 5 ul 10 uM Rev primer (GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCTaagttgataacggactagcc), 0.125 ug sgRNA plasmid library (or 0.5 ug genomic DNA) with water to 40 ul, and 50 ul 2X KAPA HIFI HS RM (Roche, Cat No.: 7958935001).
Run 1st Round PCR: 95C for 2 min; 21 cycles (genomic DNA) or 8 cycles (plasmids) [increase to 27/15 cycles if using Nanopore] of (98C for 20s, 55C for 20s, 72C for 20s); 72C for 1 min; 4C forever.

Purify 1st round products: Mix all 100 ul reactions. Take 100 ul and add 60 ul (0.6X) SPRIselect; incubate 5 min, clear supernatant on magnet. Transfer 150 ul supernatant to new tube, add 60 ul SPRIselect, incubate 5 min, clear on magnet. Wash 3x with 300 ul 80% ethanol and elute in 40 ul EB buffer.
2nd Round PCR: Set up reaction with 20 ul 10X plate TT set A primer (or 5 ul 10 uM IDT TT set A 1-10 primers + 15 ul H2O), 30 ul PCR1 elution, and 50 ul 2X KAPA HotStart ReadyMix.
Run 2nd Round PCR: 98C for 45s; 8 cycles of (98C for 20s, 62C for 10s, 72C for 10s); 72C for 1 min; 4C forever.

Post-PCR Purification: Mix 70 ul (0.7X) SPRIselect with 100 ul PCR products; incubate 5 min, clear supernatant on magnet. Transfer 150 ul supernatant to new tube, add 30 ul SPRIselect, incubate 5 min, clear on magnet. Wash 3x with 300 ul 80% ethanol and elute with 35 ul EB.
Verify library: Use Qubit (expected 1-30 ng/ul) and Agilent TapeStation (expected size 275 bps).

steps.title: Submit for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Submit libraries for Illumina NovaSeq 6000 or Oxford Nanopore sequencing.

substeps.instruction: For Nanopore (Ligation sequencing amplicons - Native Barcoding Kit 24 V14 SQK-NBD114.24), apply these modifications: 1) End-prep part 11: use 19 ul instead of 15 ul AMPure XP Beads; 2) Native barcode ligation part 11: use 1.0X instead of 0.4X AMPure XP beads; 3) Adapter ligation and clean-up part 9: use 50 ul instead of 20 ul AMPure XP beads.

steps.title: Transfect 293T Cells for Virus Packaging
steps.instruction: Seed 293T (WT) cells at 5.5X10^6 cells per 10cm dish the day before transfection. Verify cell health and density before proceeding.

substeps.instruction: Mix DNA in a sterile tube (per 10-cm dish: 8 ug transgene, 6 ug psPAX2, 2 ug pMD2G).
Add 1ml Opti-MEM per plate to the DNA tube and mix/vortex.
Add 64 ul Transporter 5 transfection reagent per plate to the tube, vortex 5 seconds, and gently spin down.
Gently pipette the mixture up and down 3 times, then add 1ml per plate to cells, spreading around the plate.
Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Collect and Concentrate Virus
steps.instruction: Collect virus 48 hours after media change.

substeps.instruction: Pre-chill Beckman Optima XL-100K centrifuge to 4C.
Draw media into a 10 ml or larger syringe and filter through a 0.45um filter into sterile tubes.
For concentration: Filter into ultracentrifuge tubes (25-30ml per tube), supplementing with DMEM if needed. Balance buckets.
Concentrate using SW28 Rotor at 25,000 rpm @ 4C for 90 minutes.
Pour out supernatant and resuspend in complete mTeSR+CloneR2.
Bleach all materials that contacted virus using 50% bleach.
Store remaining virus at 4C or use fresh for titering.

steps.title: Prepare Single-Cell Suspension of ESC/iPSCs
steps.instruction: Detach cultured ESCs and iPSCs into a single-cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Remove media, wash with 2ml PBS, and remove PBS.
Add 1ml TrypLE Select and incubate at 37C for up to 15min (check every 3min until cells round and detach with a firm tap).
Pipette to dissociate cells, then add 4ml PBS to neutralize.
Spin at 300 g for 5min and remove supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in media + Rock Inhibitor; pipette thoroughly to break clusters and separate cells from Matrigel.
Spin at 300 g for 5min; remove supernatant (watch for the 'pop' indicating Matrigel layer removal).
Resuspend pellet in appropriate volume of media.

steps.title: Measure Lentiviral Titer in hESCs/iPSCs
steps.instruction: Measure the titer of lentivirus using H9/WTC11 cells.

substeps.instruction: Culture target cells to 80% confluency (~2M cells/well). 4-5 hours before infection, replace media with media containing CloneR2.
Prepare cells as single-cell suspension (Part 5), resuspending in ~1ml media+RockI per 2 wells.
Aliquot 1M cells per condition, spin at 300*g for 5 min at RT, and remove supernatant completely.
Resuspend pellet in media+CloneR2 at 1M cells/1ml and transfer to clean wells of a 6-well Ultra-Low Attachment plate.
Add virus (starting points: 10ul, 50ul, 200ul). If using concentrated virus, spike in 10% with a different fluorophore for MOI estimation.
Incubate at 37C/5% CO2 for 3 hours, shaking or tapping every 30 min to keep cells in suspension.
Plate cells into new 6-well Matrigel coated plates with an additional 1ml media+CloneR2; incubate at 37C/5% CO2.
Measure titer 2 days later: Collect cells (Part 5), resuspend at ~10M cells/ml (~100-200ul/well), and measure BFP+ cells via flow cytometry.
Calculate virus amount for full-scale infection, accounting for ~10% loss due to 4C storage.

steps.title: Perform Large-Scale Lentiviral Infection
steps.instruction: Infect sgRNA lentivirus into H9/WTC11 cells 2 days after the titer infection.

substeps.instruction: Culture target cells to 80% confluency (~2M cells/well). 4-5 hours before infection, replace media with media containing CloneR2.
Prepare cells as single-cell suspension (Part 5), resuspending in ~1ml per 2 wells.
Aliquot cells, spin at 300*g for 5 min at RT, and remove supernatant completely.
Resuspend pellet in 1ml media+CloneR2 per 1M cells.
Add appropriate amount of virus and invert tube to mix.
Transfer to clean 6-well Ultra-Low Attachment plate at 1M cells per well.
Incubate at 37C/5% CO2 for 3 hours, shaking or tapping every 30 min.
Combine cells and add media+CloneR2 to 500k cells/ml.
Plate 2ml (1M cells) per well into new 6-well Matrigel coated plates; incubate at 37C/5% CO2.

Maintain culture with media changes every 1-2 days and split as needed. Terminate if viability is low, cells are unhealthy, or fluorophore expression is too low. Take a representative picture before the first split.

steps.title: Sort for BFP+ hESCs/iPSCs
steps.instruction: Enrich for lentivirally infected cells using FACS.

substeps.instruction: Prepare cells as single-cell suspension (Part 5) and resuspend in media+Rock Inhibitor to ~10M cells/ml.
Prepare 15ml conical tubes by adding 2ml media+Rock Inhibitor and coating the inside.
Strain cells through a 40um strainer into the tubes.
Sort for BFP+ cells using FACS and collect into prepared 15ml tubes.
Spin at 300 g for 5min and remove supernatant.
Resuspend pellets in media+CloneR2 and plate in 6-well plates (250k to 1M cells/well).
Incubate at 37C/5% CO2 with media changes every 1-2 days and split as needed.
Two weeks after infection, differentiate cells to cardiomyocytes.

steps.title: Process Sorted Cells for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Process sorted WTC11 cells for single-cell RNA-seq and sgRNA capture.

substeps.instruction: Thaw frozen WTC11 cells in a 37C water bath, transfer to 15 ml cone tube, and add ice-cold suspension medium.
Pellet cells at 250G at 4C for 5 minutes.
Wash cells by aspirating supernatant, adding 5 mL suspension medium, and pelleting again at 250G for 5 minutes. Repeat wash 2 more times.
Resuspend the final pellet in suspension medium.
Process cells using the 10x Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3' HT Reagent Kit v3.1 (Dual Index).
Sequence libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000.
